files.name: Pip V5 - static C eyes closed
files.note: Validation render C: both eyes fully shut. Eye white and pupil scale to zero about the eye centre, lash line remains. No pupil, no white crescent, no green eyeball.

files.name: Pip V5 - static B arm raised
files.note: Validation render B: waving arm at 27 deg. Shoulder socket is a disc centred on the pivot, so the joint stays sealed at every angle.

files.name: Pip V5 - static A neutral
files.note: Validation render A: every component assembled. 1 connected component, no enclosed gaps, belly intact.

files.name: Pip V5 - layered rig (editable SVG)
files.note: Back-to-front: hind legs, arms, torso, belly, head, facial features. Every part a closed Catmull-Rom Bezier path with its pivot; arms stored as point lists so the wave bends the geometry rather than hinging it.

files.name: Pip V5 - animation key frames
files.note: Frames 0, 15, 18, 34, 42, 50, 58, 71: neutral, blink closing, shut, wave rising, peak, peak, settling, neutral.

files.name: Pip V5 - 3s test (blink + wave)
files.note: All 72 frames verified: 1 component, 0 enclosed gaps, 0px white at any pivot, belly 43014-43036px, blink 178px to 0 with the pupil vanishing in lockstep, no motion spikes.
